purpose: Training-only output-format diagnosis; no belief-accuracy or confirmation claim
selection: First admitted training group in frozen manifest order; all four initial participants in CSV initial-record order
failure_policy: Record every format failure and continue all predeclared cases; stop on resource, runtime or integrity failure. No retries, repair, extraction, renormalization or choosing another prompt.
analysis: Paired format validity by model and condition; token-cap hits and repeated-four-token-gram fraction. Never read validation cases, labels or reserve payloads.
progression: All four assistant-prefill results must be strictly valid for BOTH models before considering a separate new validation protocol. This gate does not authorize an automatic validation rerun.
limitation: The adapter was trained on message text; successful prefilling would establish output compatibility only. Prefix bytes are declared input, never counted as generated text. Conditions have unequal input-token lengths and can consume unequal total tokens.
wall_budget_enforcement: Root coordinator enforces one 900-second stage deadline across both sequential watchdogs; arm runner has defensive per-process cap. Report rejects combined supervisor time over900 seconds.
